title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Whether Geological Engineering Survey Institutes and Other Units Performing Survey Duties and Their Staff Members Can Become the Relevant Criminal Subjects Prescribed in Article 229 of the Criminal Law

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Procuratorate
October 27, 2015
Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Whether Geological Engineering Survey Institutes and Other
Units and Their Staff Performing Survey Duties Can
Become the Relevant Criminal Subjects as Prescribed in
Article 229 of the Criminal Law
(Adopted at the 39th Session of the Twelfth Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate
on August 19, 2015)
Gao Jian Fa Shi Zi [2015] No. 4
Chongqing Municipal People's Procuratorate:
Your request, Yu Jian (Yan) [2015] No. 8, entitled "Request for Instructions on Whether Geological Engineering Survey Institutes Can Become Relevant Criminal Subjects under Article 229 of the Criminal Law", has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
During the process of performing survey, prospecting, and mapping duties, geological engineering survey institutes and other units and their staff that intentionally provide false engineering geological survey reports and other certification documents, if the circumstances are serious, shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of providing false certification documents in accordance with Article 229(1) and Article 231 of the Criminal Law; during the process of performing survey, prospecting, and mapping duties, geological engineering survey institutes and other units and their staff that are grossly negligent, and the engineering geological survey reports and other certification documents they issue are materially inaccurate, causing serious consequences, shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of issuing certification documents that are materially inaccurate in accordance with Article 229(3) and Article 231 of the Criminal Law.
This reply is given.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
October 27, 2015
